Author bio: Principal Designer, Builder & AI Strategist @ https://t.co/nCSnyIyr6O (NYSE: XYZ) Views are my own. Currently working on Buzz https://t.co/74AvLgvc46
Text: Hermes agents from @NousResearch  built by among others  the great @Teknium is everything I had hoped @faktoryai would one day be, when we raised back in 23. 

We were too early, believed for too long that we didn't need programming agents as part of the equation. 

To be honest though, even if all those things had gone right, I still think Hermes would still have won the agent game. Their harness is that good.

But I'm not complaining. If it hadn't happened the way it did, I wouldn't have started rejoined Block and thus not have started working on https://t.co/74AvLgvc46 which I think is a completely new category and the first network to treat Hermes, Claude Code, Codex, Grok and any other AI harness as first class citizens.

So it all worked out in the end.
